page.notes: The woodcut initial at the start of "Quot" is unclear; the likely letter Q is given with [?]. The syllogism numbers (1 to 4) and braces beside the schemes are printed and are kept in their lines. Spelling was normalised only for u/v and i/j, as instructed. The printed long s appears as "f" in "funt" and "filiusfa", rendered as s. The abbreviation "filiusfa.est" is copied as printed. The text ends mid-word at "univer-" with a printed hyphen, continuing on the next page.
